correctness.rationale: Under nonconstant compact positive X with mean mu, the exact identity Delta=t(A-B)/(1+t mu^p) and strictly increasing A/B follow by integrating the positive cross-product (t2-t1)(w-z)(v-z)(w-v). Strict Jensen at t=0 and infinity gives the zero-count and sign classification, including p=1 where H(0)=0. Curvature establishes strict support bracket, direct rational expansion gives the cubic formula, and -6q+4q^3<0 proves both sharp nonattained limits. The attached checker was extracted and run on the actual package; finite tests are diagnostic only. No sign or boundary assumptions are omitted.

value.rationale: Spatially averaging heterogeneous soil-salinity input before applying the calibrated nonlinear crop yield curve is a genuine agricultural scaling question. The theorem identifies exactly when this loses or gains predicted yield relative to distributed computation, and the explicit cubic threshold with contrast-dependent sharp interval is a natural usable invariant of the published p=3 response. It resolves a direction-of-bias ambiguity absent from the examined empirical aggregation literature. This is an idealized benchmark, not a field forecast.
